title: Microsoft Skype Chromium Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Skype. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The issue results from the use of a vulnerable version of Google Chromium. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
